projects.After the Tide: The still picture in After the Tide was AI-generated for this demo. Its title, subtitle, rule and camera move are editable Arya layers.

stills.After the Tide: The still picture in After the Tide was AI-generated for this demo.

editions.Mac App Store: The After the Tide screens on Mac come from the Mac App Store build of Arya 1.1.0. Screens in the direct Mac build can differ.

mac-color.label: Color on Mac
mac-color.alt: Arya on Mac, Color page. The viewer shows a coastal scene at dusk under the title After the Tide. Beside it, a Color inspector with a waveform scope and Lift, Gamma, Gain and Offset wheels. Below, a timeline with a Subtitle track and a Titles track.

mac-edit.label: Edit on Mac
mac-edit.alt: Arya on Mac, Edit page. A Media panel with one image, the viewer showing a coastal scene at dusk under the title After the Tide, a Project inspector set to 1,920 by 1,080 at 30 frames per second, and a timeline with Subtitle, Titles, Design and Picture tracks.
mac-edit.caption: The Edit page on Mac. Media, viewer, Project inspector and timeline share one window, with the six pages as tabs along the top.

ipad-color.label: Color on iPad
ipad-color.alt: Arya on iPad, Color page. The viewer shows a coastal scene at dusk under the title After the Tide, beside a Color inspector with Exposure at 0.2, Temperature at 0.35, a Lift wheel and rows for nodes, scopes and LUTs. Below, a four-track timeline and a tab bar for the six pages.

iphone-edit.label: Edit on iPhone
iphone-edit.alt: Arya on iPhone, Edit page. The viewer shows a coastal scene at dusk with the title After the Tide selected. Below it, a timeline with a Subtitle track and a Titles track, and a tab bar for Media, Edit, Motion, Color, Audio and Deliver.

mac-color-inspector.label: Color inspector on Mac
mac-color-inspector.alt: Color inspector on Mac for the clip Coastal arrival. A primary grade with a waveform scope in IRE and Lift, Gamma, Gain and Offset wheels.
mac-color-inspector.caption: The Color inspector on Mac, at the size it has on screen: a waveform scope of the picture above the Lift, Gamma, Gain and Offset wheels.

mac-motion-inspector.label: Motion inspector on Mac
mac-motion-inspector.alt: Motion inspector on Mac. A shape layer named Golden hour, a Position X key value of 1,640, Set key at playhead, Previous and Next, a Smooth easing menu, and rows for all keys, the motion graph and property key lanes.
mac-motion-inspector.caption: The Motion inspector on Mac, at the size it has on screen: a Position X key on a shape layer, with easing, the motion graph and key lanes below.

mac-media-panel.label: Media panel on Mac
mac-media-panel.alt: Media panel on Mac. A search field, a filter set to All, a folder named media and one image, coastal-arrival.png, with a thumbnail of a coastal scene at dusk.
mac-media-panel.caption: The Media panel on Mac, at the size it has on screen, holding the one image this project uses.

ipad-color-inspector.label: Color on iPad
ipad-color-inspector.alt: Color inspector on iPad for the clip Coastal arrival. Curves for a primary grade, with Y, R, G and B buttons, an S-shaped luma curve through four points, and Add point and Remove point.

iphone-deliver.label: Deliver on iPhone
iphone-deliver.alt: Deliver sheet on iPhone. An export range of 00:00:00:00 to 00:00:12:00 at 1,920 by 1,080 and 30 frames per second, an Export video button, the line Export saved to renders/Export.mp4, a completed H.264 High quality Export.mp4 in the render queue and a saved export with a Share export button.
iphone-deliver.caption: The Deliver sheet on iPhone after this export finished: twelve seconds of H.264 at 1,920 × 1,080 and 30 fps, saved to the project’s renders folder and ready to share.

after-the-tide.label: Exported on iPhone
after-the-tide.description: A 12 second clip without sound. A slow push in on a coastal scene at dusk: a figure in an orange raincoat on a pier watches a ferry, under the title After the Tide.
after-the-tide.caption: The file that export produced, shown here as a 720p copy without sound. Arya on iPhone rendered it at 1,920 × 1,080 in H.264.
